summary: Grid push puzzles composing selected graph navigation for deterministic pursuit, bounded command ingress and reversible turns.
useWhen: Add chambers to Stonewake-style puzzles or study sequential occupied-grid pursuit using a selected pure graph-query provider and one-command-per-tick ingress.
limitations: Undo restores this ruleset's discrete board state, not arbitrary shared mechanics or a general ECS snapshot.
Shared command ingress and graph traversal are genre-neutral; push legality, gate exclusions, golem occupancy/cadence, queue capacity and transition clearing remain family policies.
Static authored chamber connectivity remains a registration-time local validator, separate from selected runtime navigation.
